1 (Currently Amended): A method of using a finger palette to transfer cosmetics from a container to a destination, the finger palette including: i. a ring portion that is securable to a finger; and ii. a surface portion secured to the ring portion, the surface portion being at least substantially smooth to allow a user to spread or blend cosmetic product on the surface portion; b. the method including the steps of: i. securing the finger palette to a finger; ii. [[depositing]] __placing or depositing__ a cosmetic product onto the surface portion of the finger palette; and iii. transferring the cosmetic product from the surface portion of the finger palette to a destination.

4 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein: a. a first quantity of the cosmetic product is deposited onto the surface portion; and b. a second quantity of the cosmetic product is transferred from the surface portion to the destination, the second quantity being smaller than the first quantity and wherein the transferred second quantity is applied to a selected area instead of being directly applied.

6 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially free of protrusions extending therefrom that could interfere with the application of the cosmetic product.

7 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the surface portion is at least substantially planar and conducive to the even application of cosmetics. 

11 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the finger palette is secured to the finger by passing the finger through the ring portion and wherein the ring portion includes an adjustable mechanism for securing to different finger sizes.
